title: Airy energy spaces and the actual weak boundary data
reviewed_arguments: E0 fixes the full affine strip, conic support, two-thirds scaling, actual H1 norm and real Airy Wronskian. E1 derives the growing Bi normalization and both positive endpoint integral bounds from exact earlier Airy proofs.

E2 controls the complete complex two-mode Gram matrix on the oscillating interval. One integration by parts bounds every cross term; the remaining compact parameter range is treated through positive definiteness and the Wronskian.
E3 proves the two-sided full collar estimate with the exponential Bi boundary-layer weight. The positive mixed term is bounded and its Ai contribution is absorbed by the oscillating collar energy.
E4 gives a complete weighted L2 coefficient space, both H1 norm inequalities, injectivity and closed range. Frequency truncations converge in the actual energy norm.
E5 derives the sharp single-mode input weight, all three Sobolev regimes, the exact equality of the two elliptic contributions and the non-diagonal conversion for pairs.

E6 proves completeness for every H1 solution in the stated cone: Fubini and countable tests yield the weak ODE, the weak fundamental theorem supplies endpoint data, and the Wronskian and ordered ODE uniqueness give measurable unique coefficients.
E7 proves the H1/2 value trace, H-1/2 conormal trace, compatibility with the existing graph trace and the signed Green identity for every legal energy test.

E8 identifies both actual weak boundary domains, the trace right inverse, arbitrary complex Fourier-matrix Robin matching and the stable energy constraint. Constant Robin matrices are realized by explicit derivative-on-test lower terms.

E9 constructs finite-energy glancing-concentrating packets, including homogeneous Dirichlet and Neumann solutions, whose unique normalized mode coefficients are non-tempered. A translated-test seminorm argument proves the obstruction. The unnormalized Airy coefficients remain in the exact energy space.

E10 transfers the full weak form, both test slots, natural antidual and conormal row through actual boundary-preserving half-density maps and bounded invertible complex gauges. Its conjugate class is not identified with the general canonical normal form.

Three solved exercises prove the exact bilinear energy primitives, failure of a single-mode H1/2-to-H1 bound and the full nilpotent gauge boundary row. The reproducible figure retains both Gram eigenvalues and both single-mode weights.

All 15 local nodes bind to 598 earlier entries in 31 exact current maps, with 102 external Lebl providers. The general variable-coefficient representation and propagation remain unfinished; the disproved two-tempered-input claim is excluded from the continuation target.
